linkedin.headline: Firmware engineer | Gearwhistle Robotics
linkedin.about: I write firmware for small robots and contribute to open source projects. I am independent, deadpan and happiest at a workbench with a soldering iron. I need quiet time to recharge, so I usually stay in on weeknights. I would like a partner who is comfortable with comfortable silence.

experience.title: Firmware Engineer
experience.description: Embedded C and robotics control loops; maintain an open source motor library.
